content: Nâwe mwene omuntu, yanka engôrho nyôji, oyifumbarhe nka lwembe lumôma bwânwa, yigeze oku irhwe lyâwe n’oku bwânwa bwâwe. Kandi wânarhôla omunzani, wânarhondêra okugera n’okugabanya erya migohe y’e­mvîri watwâga.

Ecigabi ciguma ca kasharhu, wânacidulika muliro omu karhî k’olugo, ago mango olugo lwâbalugorhe. Wânashubirhôla ecindi cihimbi ca kasharhu wânaja wâcitwa n’engôrho, kuzunguluka olugo loshi. Ecindi cihimbi ca kasharhu cizinda, wânacibuha cihêkwe n’empûsi, erhi nâni namâyisha nyômwîre engôrho enyuma zâbo.
Kandi wanashubirholakwo rhundi rhuviri rhusungunu, orhugonyere omu muhiro gw’ecishûli câwe.
Kuli orhôla rhuviri wânashubirhôla kwo kandi rhusungunu, orhukwêbe omu karhî k’omuliro ona­rhuyôce. Rhwânagarha muliro.
Kandi, wânabwîra omulala gwa bene Israheli boshi, erhi: Ntyâla kwo adesire Nyakasane Nyamubâho, alaga Yeruzalemu nasimikaga ekarhî k’amashanja, âzungulukwa n’ebihugo by’ihanga.
Yeruzalemu abîre mugoma, anahemukîre engeso zâni kulusha amashanja, agayaguza àmarhegeko gâni kulusha ebihugo bimuli eburhambi, bulya àgayire engeso zâni n’amarhegeko gâni arhagashimba.

Co cirhumire aderha ntyâla Nyakasane Nyamubâho, erhi; Ebwa kubà mwabîre bagoma kulusha amashanja gamuzongolosire, murhashimba amarhegeko gâni, murhanalanga engeso zâni, na ciru murhashimba engeso z’amashanja gamuzongolosire,
okwôla kwamarhuma aderha ntyâla Nyakasane Nyamubâho, erhi: «Nâni ntà kuli kwo, nkola nakuhira kwo amahanya, embaga zoshi zirhangâle».
Nâjira ntyôla kuli we oku ntasagijira, ntakanacikujira bundi, n’ecarhuma gali agôla mabî gâwe magalugalu.
Co carhuma, b’îshe w’abâna bakola bakazilîra abâna bâbo ekarhî kâwe, n’abâna balye b’îshe wâbo. Nâkuhonda kwo amahane nnanshandabanye abâna bâwe bacisigîre bajè enyunda zoshi z’igulu.

Co cirhumire, ndahîre oku buzîne bwâni, Nyakasane Nyamubâho okudesire, ebwa kubà wahemwîre ahantu hâni hatagatîfu n’amabî gâwe magalugalu, nâni nkola nâmujandika buzira masù ga bwonjo na buzira kubabalira.

Cihimbi ciguma ca kasharhu c’abantu bâwe bafà n’ecihûsi, ishali lyâbamalirira ekarhî kâwe, ecindi cihimbi ca kasharhu engôrho yâci­malirira eburhambi bwâwe n’ecindi cihimbi ca kasharhu cicisigîre nâcishandabaganya balibirhe erhi n’engôrho ebali omu nyuma.
Lêro obwo, obukunizi bwâni bwânarhimukwa n’oburhè bwâni bwânarhûlirira kuli bo bulya namâcîhôla; ntyo banamanya oku niene Nyamubâho, nie nahigaga ntyo erhi lûji lurhuma, nâbayûkizakwo oburhè bwâni.
Nâwe wêne, nâkujira bwêrûlè, wâbà embere z’amashanja gakuzongolosire na ngasi bagera boshi.

Wâbà masheka, kantu ka nshonyi, lwîganyo lwa kuyôbohya oku mashanja gakuzonzire amango nakujirira ebyôla byoshi omu bucîranuzi bwâni haguma n’oburhè n’obukunizi n’amahane makali. Nie Nyamubâho okudesire.
Omu kukurhumira enyampi yâni mikali y’ecizombo, yo yanakumalîra bulya nayirhuma ekuheze, ciru nanyûshûle eryo ishali kuli we, -nânaherêrekeza omugati olya, ogu wali ocicîbikîre.
Nâkurhumira ecizombo n’ebiryanyi bikali bikazikulya abâna; ecihûsi n’omukò byâgera emwâwe. Nâkurhurnira n’engôrho ekumalîre. Nie Nyamubâho okudesire.
